abstract: Domain.com hosting is cheap in year one and about three times dearer at renewal. It lists a 99% uptime guarantee, we found no independent speed test, and Domain.com is becoming Network Solutions.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is simple to start. Renewal is about three times the first-year price, and we found no independent speed test.

mainEntity.name: How much does Domain.com hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starter is $35.88 for the first year and $105.99 a year at renewal. Essential is $59.88 then $184.99. Premium is $83.88 then $224.99.

mainEntity.name: Is Domain.com the same as Network Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Domain.com is becoming Network Solutions, according to HowToHosting. Both sit under Newfold Digital.

mainEntity.name: What is the Domain.com uptime guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its plan page lists 99%, which allows about 7 hours of downtime a month.

mainEntity.name: Does Domain.com have a free domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential and Premium include a free domain and SSL for 1 year.

mainEntity.name: Does Domain.com have an AI website builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: HostAdvice reports one on all plans. Our read of the hosting page did not list one.
TechRadar notes phone support. Domain.com's page lists 24/7 chat.
HostAdvice says privacy is on by default. TechRadar says free domain privacy is not included. Check the checkout.
Reviewers warn about upselling and steep renewals. Renewal rates show only at checkout in one review.

mainEntity.name: How steep is the Domain.com renewal price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starter renews at 3.0 times the first-year price, Essential at 3.1 times and Premium at 2.7 times.
We found no independent WordPress test. Compare hosts with published speed results.
Anyone who plans to stay for years, wants proven speed or wants a strong uptime promise.
